The one quality Rockefeller ranked above all others.

Kevin explains Rockefeller's view that no other quality is so essential to success of any kind as perseverance. It overcomes almost everything, even nature.

His challenge: when adversity shows up, do you quit or keep going, consistent and persistent? Kevin says success is a decision away, and once you make it, the whole universe comes to your aid.

Where in your life do you most need to keep going?
